item.title: Open PDF Editor 0.3.0
item.description: Page management. Rotate, delete, insert blank pages, crop and extract pages from the new Pages menu or by right-clicking thumbnails. Select several thumbnails to change them together, and drag them to put pages in a new order. Insert the pages of another PDF, or drop PDFs, images and other documents between the thumbnails to add them. Split a document every few pages or at its bookmarks, make one PDF from a set of files (PDFs, images, EPUB, Word, Excel, PowerPoint and more) with File › Create PDF from Files, and save a smaller copy with File › Reduce File Size. Every change can be undone. ⌘L and ⌘R now turn pages; turning just the view is ⌥⌘L and ⌥⌘R.
